package.name: whill_dispatch
package.description:
M7 dispatch (配車) API boundary for the WHILL chair. A single `dispatch_node` sits between the Web/tablet UI and Nav2: it resolves named waypoints, queues dispatch jobs (FIFO), drives Nav2 as a NavigateToPose action client, and folds vehicle pose + queue state into a `/dispatch/state` topic. The Web side never touches `/navigate_to_pose` or `/cmd_vel*` directly (platform-pivot §5 #4); it only speaks the four `/dispatch/*` interfaces over rosbridge.
Web boundary is JSON-over-std_msgs/String + std_srvs/Trigger (no custom rosidl interface — ADR-0012, demo-scope choice A). The static Web UI (roslibjs, vendored) and the launch that stands up rosbridge_websocket + an http.server + an optional mock action server all live in this package so the whole demo boundary is one `ros2 launch whill_dispatch dispatch_launch.py`.
Mutually exclusive with nothing at the TF layer — dispatch adds no TF and no cmd_vel. Runs alongside `m6r_bringup_launch.py` (whill_safety) + `nav_launch.py` (whill_navigation) at demo time.
